How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
Orders currently take an average of 1–2 business days to process before shipping. After that, estimated transit time within the contiguous U.S. is 1–3 days to the West Coast, 3–4 days to the Central U.S., 4–5 days to the Midwest, and 5–7 days to the East Coast. Delivery times can vary.
You’ll receive a tracking email when your order is ready to ship. Our delivery page has the latest estimates.
